notes: Governing documents in force on 2018-02-26: HOP 4.20 Authorized Leave (published 2017-02-23), HOP 2.06 (2017-11-07), HOP 2.10 (2016-02-24), Regents' Rule 31007 (amended 2016-02-10), Regents' Rule 30201 (amended 2017-03-06). Missing is false: HOP 4.20 and Rule 30201 are leave policies and HOP 2.10 sets the tenure clock.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave and no modified-duties policy for new parents appears in the saved sources. Birth-related time is FMLA (c1) with the employee's own sick (and, for 12-month appointees, vacation) balances running concurrently; beyond FMLA, faculty may request medical leave or a reduced work schedule at the dean's discretion (HOP 2.06; c7, c8).

U8: the state parental leave (Tex. Gov't Code 661.913; HOP 4.20 'Parental Leave'; Rule 30201 Sec. 6) applies only to employees who do not qualify for FMLA (up to 12 weeks from the birth or placement of a child under three, sick and vacation used first, the rest unpaid). The member described (two years of service) qualifies for FMLA, so it is recorded in c1's duration_note, not as a component.

Not components (cannot be used for the birth or adoption): bereavement emergency leave (death in the family, up to 3 work days), military leave, court appearance and jury service, voting, administrative leave with pay (a performance reward of up to 32 hours a year), volunteer firefighter and EMS leave, foster parent leave (attending protective-services and school meetings about a foster child), educational activities (8 hours of sick leave for school events), Red Cross disaster service, assistance-dog training, organ, marrow and blood donation, faculty development leave (Rule 30201 Sec. 4, HOP 2.25), servicemember family leave.
Calendar: HOP 2.06 refers to the 'long semester' and 'long-session semester'; kind of term stated (semester) without a length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

HOP 2.06 says a faculty member approved for leave or a reduced work schedule 'will continue on their regular appointment' (c7, c8); whether this means pay continues is not stated. c7 is coded as a leave with payer none; c8 as relief with full pay inferred and the R3 flag. Neither has a stated length, so neither adds weeks.

Tenure clock: HOP 2.10 implements Regents' Rule 31007 Sec. 5.1(b) (system guidelines); coded once (c11) with both documents. The Regents' rule allows requests up to three months before the mandatory review; HOP 2.10 requires six months; HOP 2.10 (the campus policy) governs. Periods of approved leave of absence are excluded from the probationary period (c12; any leave, general purpose).
